time.out_of_order_definition: An event whose observed_s is less than the greatest observed_s already received by arrival time.

association.camera: Associate classification observations to a radar track when both spatial and time gates pass; preserve each label and its source evidence.
association.remote_id: Associate only when both gates pass; otherwise retain as a separate report.
association.rf: A time-window match may be retained as context only. Never infer emitter-to-track identity or causation from this rule.

late_evidence.retention: Keep original event in fixture/audit input; exclude it from current correlation result.

sensor_health.result: Emit coverage_loss for the affected sensor; do not infer missing observations.

identity_and_threat.conflicting_labels: Preserve all labels; report identity as unidentified when evidence conflicts.
identity_and_threat.threat_status: undetermined unless an independently defined and validated rule establishes otherwise.
